name: projn32_qwen2_5_0p5b
description: Multi-lane projection y = requant(W x): 32 columns at once, each lane taking its own byte of a 256-bit weight word, sized to consume zybo_z7_20's sustained DDR bandwidth

derivation.rule: depth, column and address widths from the matmul sequencer, which is sized from the model's largest dimension; the requantizer from that block
derivation.lanes_rule: smallest power of two with lanes * clock * data bytes >= sustained DDR bandwidth

ports.name: w_addr
ports.desc: weight word address: group g, row r at g * depth + r

ports.name: w_data
ports.desc: lane j's weight in bits [8*j+7:8*j], registered read

behavior: Columns are processed in groups of 32. Group g covers columns g*32 .. g*32+31; in the last group, lanes past cols produce nothing.

For each group, rows r = 0..depth-1 are read: a_addr = r and w_addr = g*depth + r, both registered reads whose data arrives the cycle after the address. Lane j of the word is the weight of column g*32 + j at row r.
Each lane accumulates a[r] * w_j over the rows in its own MAC, the supplied mac module, one instance per lane, cleared between groups.
Each column's sum is requantized by the supplied requant module with scale and shift, and emitted with o_valid high for one cycle and o_index its column. Each column exactly once, in order.
busy is high from start until the last output has been emitted.
